title: Business Bronze Rewards Card: Understanding Your 1% Cash Back Rewards
summary: Explains how the Business Bronze Rewards Card earns 1.0% cash back on eligible purchases, calculated on the net transaction amount after credits or returns. Covers how to track rewards in the account dashboard and redeem once available rewards reach at least $37 (typically as a statement credit).
faqs: How much cash back do I earn with the Business Bronze Rewards Card?
Are rewards based on the purchase total or the net amount after returns/credits?
When do my cash back rewards update on my account?
Where can I monitor my earned and available rewards?
